# Pancake (raw): a 12-sided disc 0.54 across, 0.03 thick (it bakes ~0.1 thick: a disc spreads
# past its faces), origin at its centre so it flips about it. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Top --base-color 1.0000 0.9686 0.8941 --no-slot
material new Edge --base-color 1.0000 0.9020 0.7765 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pancake --vertices 12 --radius 0.27 --depth 0.03 --location 0 0 0
material assign Edge
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
material assign Top
mode object
shade flat
export pancake_raw.glb
